title: 9041 Lab 2
text:
Methods

Participants


Measures
The Attachment and Social Anxiety data set consists of 3 scales. The first one is the Social Interaction Anxiety Scale (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.9). The second one is the Experiences in Close Relationships Anxiety Subscale (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.94). The third one is the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.85).


Data Analysis Strategy
Here it is important to note that we have reverse keyed items 5, 9, and 11 in the Social Interaction Anxiety Scale responses, and reverse keyed items 2, 5, 6, 8, and 9 in the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale.
